<div class="card-body">
'''Vader's Lightsaber''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーのライトセーバー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">必ずベイダーに配備すること（コストなし）。このカードがある場所のフォース消耗に＋1できる。武器使用時は、コストなしで1名のキャラクターに対して起動できる。運命数を2回引き、運命数の合計＞能力値なら、そのキャラクターに命中し、没収値＝0にできる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダーの自作。クローン大戦の後、彼はこの武器を振るってジェダイたちを狩りたてた。他のライトセーバーの刃以外なら、何でも切断できる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Vader's Lightsaber.

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on Vader at no cost. You may add 1 to the Force drain where this card is. You may fire at one character at no cost. Draw destiny twice. If total destiny exceeds the character's ability, it is hit and its forfeit can be reduced to 0.

'''Lore:''' Built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars he used it to hunt Jedi. It can cut anything except another lightsaber blade.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Vader's Lightsaber|Vader's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R50 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Vaders-Lightsaber-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
